verdict.rationale: First-party docs say Claude Code can run in CI and be chained with other tools, with GitHub Actions or GitLab CI/CD automating code review and issue triage. Scheduled runs and ANTHROPIC_API_KEY authentication, which skips the login prompt, support unattended automation. missing for 10: documentation of the specific non-interactive/headless invocation mode (flags, output formats), independent hands-on corroboration of CI usage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: Pipe logs into it, run it in CI, or chain it with other tools
In CI, you can automate code review and issue triage with GitHub Actions or GitLab CI/CD.
Run Claude on a schedule to automate work that repeats
If you've set the ANTHROPIC_API_KEY environment variable, Claude Code skips the login prompt
